Known for her stentorian delivery of comical and risqué songs, she was one of the most popular entertainers in America during the first half of the 20th century. The family fortune suffered during the civil war. William Means went to Memphis, Tennessee and practiced law with T. B. Chambers from 1872 to 1874. He married Corallie Bulloch, daughter of a prominent Mississippi family, while in Memphis. They moved back to Blackwelder's Spring. Soon after Gaston was born William moved the family to Concord. name: Emma Horvitz
text_excerpt: Emma Horvitz is the wife of Philadelphia kosher butcher and gangster Manny Horvitz. An unseen character through Season 2, she finally debuts in the Season 3 premiere "Resolution", played by Yelena Shmulenson. Biography Background Like her husband, Emma is Jewish and a first generation immigrant, likely from Eastern Europe. Her main language is Yiddish. She moved to the United States with her husband in 1903. The two have a daughter together. ("What Does the Bee Do?", "Resolution") Season 2 Manny mentions his love for his wife while negotiating a deal with Jimmy Darmody in April 1921, despite the fact that "her ankles got thick". When Mickey Doyle visits Manny at his house in order to pay Jimmy's debt in bootleg liquor, Manny forbids Doyle from sitting on a knitted armchair saying that his wife "would kill" Manny if he allowed him to. ("What Does the Bee Do?", "Georgia Peaches") After Manny murders Angela Darmody, Manny goes into hiding in order to protect his wife and daughter.

text_excerpt: Hank, played by Ned Noyes, is a salesman at the Chicago branch of the Farrady Electric Iron company. Biography Season 3 Phil wins the annual sales competition for 1922 and celebrates New Year's Eve with his colleagues at an office party. They mock George Mueller when he returns with enough sales to win, but after the deadline. The salesmen play a prank on Mueller, covering his face and shirt with ink from a gag pen. He is mortified and tries to hide from their boss, Scotty Gulliver. When Van Alden returns to work the next day his colleagues brush off the prank as an initiation. They invite him for a drink at Herkemeyer's speakeasy. The evening sours when the venue is raided by Prohibition Agents.
